title: Mom From Hell Drags Her Son Into Dispute With Ex-Husband
description:
#crime_news #bodycam #crime 

On September 13th, 2024. Officers were called to a residence involving two ex parents having a dispute on where their child is sleeping for the night. It all started when mom drove over to her ex-husbands sisters house to confront him about not giving her money for the child's haircut.  This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.

#news
